potential_name: Purja Pun and Mishin (2009) Ni-Al EAM
authors: G. P. Purja Pun and Y. Mishin
citation: G. P. Purja Pun and Y. Mishin (2009), 'Development of an interatomic potential for the Ni-Al system', Philosophical Magazine 89(34-36), 3245-3267.
fitting_scope: Binary Ni-Al potential built on established pure Al and pure Ni descriptions; cross interaction fitted to experimental cohesive energy, lattice parameter, and elastic constants of B2-NiAl plus ab initio formation energies of several real or hypothetical intermetallic compounds; intended for Ni-Al phases, heterophase interfaces, and mechanical behavior.
implementation_notes: LAMMPS eam/alloy conversion produced by Chandler Becker (13 Aug 2009) from the authors' plt tabulated functions; reference updated from in-press status on 15 Dec 2009.

comment_lines: G.P. Purja Pun and Y. Mishin, Phil. Mag., in press (2009).
LAMMPS setfl format.  Conversion by C. A. Becker from Y. Mishin files.
